02 / Initial sourcing focus

Industrial fasteners.
Sourced with clarity.

Our initial sourcing focus is industrial fasteners and related engineered components. We help buyers communicate technical requirements clearly and compare potential manufacturing options in India.

  • Hex bolts, nuts, and washers
  • Studs and threaded rods
  • Carbon steel and stainless steel fasteners
  • Standard and specification-based requirements
  • Grades, coatings, dimensions, and documentation
